Build the verified repository revision from source:

```bash
git clone https://github.com/aspose-pdf-foss/Aspose.PDF-FOSS-for-Cpp.git
cd Aspose.PDF-FOSS-for-Cpp
git checkout 40858b60e9babbab4865180e00e2db39f2ba27f8
mvn clean install
```

This path requires JDK unknown+ and Maven. The source build and the minimal example
below were verified together at revision `40858b60e9babbab4865180e00e2db39f2ba27f8`.
